attributes.name: Nualia
attributes.powers:
Before the encounter, Nualia deals 1d4 Force damage to each character at this location.

For each blessing played in a check against Nualia, the difficulty of the check is increased by 2.

"Get your filthy eyes off of me! A simpleton like you will never understand the beauty of the Mother of Monsters!"—Nualia
